text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Bus fleet modernisation on hold. Plans to upgrade the public transport service through the introduction of foreign-built buses have been put on hold by the Public Transport Authority as it considers the assembly of buses in Malta, to save money. The government was to allot 10 million Maltese lira ($27 million) to subsidise the purchase of 508 buses.
- Government considering extending plans for new hospital. The former government had started works on the building of a new state hospital to complement the existing one.
- Gozo ferry fare increases will affect internal tourism.
- Hunters association attacks London Sunday Times report of massive importation by Malta of British birds. Says the report in unfair and undermines tourism to Malta.
